node: Broadline distributors and contracted restaurant procurement
summary: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe for the restaurant broadline-distribution/procurement node. The cleanest reference exposures are Sysco, US Foods, and Performance Food Group: scaled foodservice distributors whose networks can influence restaurant input availability, delivery reliability, private-label penetration, and purchasing economics. The underfollowed discovery candidate is GEN Restaurant Group, not because it owns the distribution chokepoint, but because its filings reveal unusually high supplier concentration: Sysco represented about 76.3% of total food costs in 2024 after a three-year purchase agreement, making procurement terms a potentially material margin and operating-risk variable. No trading recommendation is implied.
